$comment: How each catalog row (CH- code) gets its V2 contract category (D-60, D-68). A row takes its kind's default unless it is named in overrides, with the reason. Categories are permanent once a Bridge ID is minted from them, so change this file only for rows that have no Bridge ID yet. The owner reviews it in docs/clubhouse/generated/CLUBHOUSE_BRIDGE_MAP.md.
